note: The script asks for the hook text, two name supers, one key-word stack, two name labels on the sisters' photos, one number pop with its source line, three top texts and the end card, so 10 graphics and the end card. The end card in the repo is AIJ's vertical animated logo; this film is 16:9, so cut in AIJ's Horizontal Animated logo from the AIJ Outros/Intros folder.

mg.title: Hook text

text.main: One of my clients is now an immigration attorney.

mg.cue: Hook text on frame 1: “One of my clients is now an immigration attorney.” Already on screen at 0:00. Does not animate on.
mg.use: Start the clip at frame 0045 (fully on) and hold it until 00:03. Top third, over Cheryl.

mg.title: Cheryl name super
mg.cue: Name super at 00:03 for 3 s, lower left: “Cheryl Little” / Co-Founder, Americans for Immigrant Justice.
mg.use: Put it on at 00:03 for 3 s. Move it lower left, above the captions. Type the second line Co-Founder, Americans for Immigrant Justice under the name.

mg.title: They have
mg.cue: Key words, one at a time as she says them, top third: “They have children.” “They have great families.” “They have jobs.”
mg.use: Each line lands as Cheryl says it, over the family B-roll. Top third. Out before “And they love America.”

mg.title: Sister Maureen
mg.cue: Name label on each photo as she names the sister: “Sister Maureen Kelleher” then “Sister Catherine Cassidy”.
mg.use: On her photo as Cheryl says her name. Move it lower left, above the captions.

mg.title: Sister Catherine
mg.cue: Name label on each photo as she names the sister: “Sister Maureen Kelleher” then “Sister Catherine Cassidy”.
mg.use: On her photo as Cheryl says her name. Move it lower left, above the captions.

mg.title: Ten times

text.label: times more likely to win their case

mg.cue: Number pop over the footage on “ten times”: 10 times more likely to win their case.
mg.use: Over the Little Haiti and Little Havana shots as the narrator says “ten times”. Type the source line small under it: Source: Vera Institute of Justice.

mg.title: 30 years
mg.cue: Top text over the footage: “30 YEARS. ONE MISSION.”
mg.use: Over the historic footage and the hotline shots, top third, while the narrator says “For three decades”.

mg.title: Sui name super
mg.cue: Name super at her first sight, lower left, 3 s: “Sui Chung” / Executive Director, Americans for Immigrant Justice.
mg.use: Put it on when Sui first appears, for 3 s. Move it lower left, above the captions. Type the second line Executive Director, Americans for Immigrant Justice under the name.

mg.title: Very different
mg.cue: Top text on “Miami would look very different.” as she says it.
mg.use: Top third, over the Miami B-roll that covers Sui, as she says the line.

mg.title: Immigrants built it
mg.cue: Top text on “Immigrants built it.” as the narrator says it.
mg.use: Top third, over the montage of people AIJ has helped, as the narrator says it.

mg.title: End card
mg.cue: AIJ’s own animated logo end card. Nothing added to it.
mg.src: AIJ's own Vertical Animated logo (Mobile Video).mp4 from the AIJ Outros/Intros pack (Drive), the newest outro AIJ has given us (endcards/index.json, 3 Nov 2025).
mg.use: After “Learn more at aijustice.org.” Hold it to the end. This repo file is AIJ's vertical logo: in this 16:9 film use AIJ's Horizontal Animated logo from the AIJ Outros/Intros folder. Do not stretch the vertical one.
